title: 노른자가 또 터졌네!

cuts.scene: Kitchen. Wife looking frustrated at a broken egg in a frying pan.
Kitchen. Husband sips coffee, glancing at wife without much emotion.
Kitchen. Wife finds a small, colorful clay toy product on the counter, pushed towards her by husband.
Kitchen. Wife carefully uses the clay toy product to separate egg white from yolk into two bowls. Yolk is intact.
Kitchen. Husband watches wife, a slight shrug as he states the obvious.
White background. Guide character holding up a product card for 'the clay toy product'. A '글쎄' (Hmm) stamp appears on the card.
Kitchen. Wife opens a drawer, revealing a forgotten kitchen gadget, a lemon squeezer.
Kitchen. Husband is back at the counter, calmly sipping coffee, in the same spot as cut 1.

situation: 아침 계란 요리 중 노른자 터짐
